topic: Virtual facility mapping visualization tool update
summary_markdown:
A new visual page was shared for displaying virtual facility mapping on the staging analytics platform. This functionality allows users to view where traffic maps from a source facility and where traffic is mapped to a target facility, as well as see nearby facilities.

Status updates indicated that while currently read-only (for viewing), future plans include adding editing capabilities to link facilities for traffic transfer. The tool is intended for internal AllUnite administrators only.

It was noted that any unmapped facilities in Brazil or Africa require manual linkage via email correspondence.
decisions: The virtual facility mapping page is currently read-only and limited to internal AllUnite admins.
action_items: Manual linking of unmapped facilities in Brazil or Africa must be handled by the designated person via email.
